title: Invoker calibration and regression harness for function selection & argument contracts
creator: Marco Green
description: Build an automated evaluation harness that continuously measures function invoker fidelity across config and model changes. The harness will track two orthogonal failure modes: 1) incorrect selector (chooses wrong function/tool for a given intent) and 2) argument contract violations (invalid types, missing required fields, or malformed payloads). This ticket scopes the infra, metric definitions, automated canary gating, and dashboards required to detect regressions caused by model upgrades, quantization changes, or runtime kernel swaps.
acceptance_criteria: Service pulls candidate model/config diffs and runs the canonical eval suite within a reproducible environment
Selector accuracy measured at top-1 and top-3 with baseline vs candidate comparison and confidence intervals
Argument validation F1 and schema-violation rates recorded per function and aggregated per model/config
Automated gating rule: fail rollout if top-1 selector accuracy drops >2 percentage points AND argument violation rate increases >0.5% for any high-risk function
Results surfaced in Console with per-route and per-function drilldowns and exportable CSV
Playbook documenting triage steps and suggested mitigations (reroute to fallback model, apply stricter schema enforcement, rollback quantization change)
test_plan: Assemble canonical test corpus: 8k labeled examples covering intent/function mapping and edge-case argument permutations
Create mutation suite that simulates model drift: prompt paraphrases, OCR-noise, tokenization edge-cases
Run baseline (current production model + config) to snapshot metrics
Run candidate variants (model vN, quantized float16/int8, kernel swap) in parallel against identical workload
Compute statistical significance for metric differences and flag regressions according to gating rules
Run synthetic negative tests to validate argument sanitizer rejects malformed payloads
automation: CI job triggers on model/config PRs and scheduled daily runs; writes results to S3 and posts summary to CI pipeline
Canary gate integration: if harness fails gating rule, create auto-issue with failure summary and link to regression artifact
Auto-generated golden artifacts: canonical examples of changed selections and malformed arguments for human review
Automated alerts to #invocation-regressions Slack channel when high-severity regressions detected
dashboards: Console -> Invocation Quality: timeline of selector accuracy and argument violation rate by model
Per-function heatmap showing frequency of schema violations and types of errors
Canary summary widget: pass/fail status for latest candidate and top offending examples
Cost vs quality view: token cost change vs selector accuracy delta
